test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight colleagues A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a circle facing the centre, not necessarily in the same order. G sits third to the left of D. E is third to the left of G. H sits to the immediate right of D. B is second to the right of E. F is an immediate neighbour of E. F is third to the left of C. Who is sitting on the immediate left of D?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. G sits third to the left of D and E is third to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/252c28decda496a619838509e9353d57035f06da1b4264bfbff59930cc0a7792.png] 

2. H sits to the immediate right of D and B is second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58a71aaa8ebde92398d8df91956fbf88bfb6146b1d5e86b0c4f160f6f57767d5.png] 

3. F is an immediate neighbour of E and F is third to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cbb46aa67aaf76609acf447b284eee26547a476cd284d4fa6beddfb895e0080.png] 

Here, **A** is sitting on the immediate left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
